items.exampleEn: We had a picnic under a big oak.
items.exampleZh: 我們在一棵大橡樹下野餐。

items.exampleEn: Birds clean their feathers every day.
items.exampleZh: 鳥每天都會整理自己的羽毛。

items.exampleEn: This year's apple harvest was very good.
There are many endangered animals in this zoo.
items.exampleZh: 這座動物園裡有很多瀕臨絕種的動物。

items.exampleEn: This dinosaur lived millions of years ago.
items.exampleZh: 這種恐龍生活在幾百萬年前。

items.exampleEn: The path to the lake is sandy, so walk slowly.
items.exampleZh: 通往湖邊的小路是沙地，所以要慢慢走。

items.exampleEn: This plant has big white blooms.
items.exampleZh: 這株植物開著大朵的白花。

items.exampleEn: I want to see the underwater world.

items.sentenceEn: This beach is sandy and clean.
items.sentenceZh: 這片海灘沙子很多，而且很乾淨。

items.audioEn: The museum has a dinosaur that is ten meters long.
items.audioZh: 博物館裡有一隻十公尺長的恐龍。
items.questionZh: 博物館裡的恐龍有多長？

items.sentenceEn: The roses in our garden are in full bloom.
items.sentenceZh: 我們花園裡的玫瑰盛開了。

items.sentenceEn: This old oak is two hundred years old.
items.sentenceZh: 這棵老橡樹已經兩百歲了。

items.stemEn: I found a long white ____ from a bird.
items.stemZh: 我撿到一根鳥掉下來的白色長羽毛。

items.stemEn: Tigers are ____, so we must keep them safe.
items.stemZh: 老虎瀕臨絕種，所以我們必須保護牠們的安全。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my family went to an island. The beaches were sandy and quiet. We took an underwater camera and saw colorful fish near the rocks. On the island, there is a very old oak tree. Farmers were busy with the rice harvest, and flowers were in bloom everywhere. At a small museum, we saw the bones of a dinosaur. I took many photos with my digital camera.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們全家去了一座島。那裡的海灘都是沙灘，而且很安靜。我們帶著水下相機，在岩石附近看到五顏六色的魚。島上有一棵非常老的橡樹。農夫們正忙著收割稻子，到處都是盛開的花。在一間小博物館裡，我們看到了恐龍的骨頭。我用數位相機拍了很多照片。

questions.questionZh: 他們在小博物館裡看到什麼？

referenceEn: This kind of bird is endangered.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 This bird is…、This kind of bird is…

items.promptZh: 我兒子很喜歡有關恐龍的書。
referenceEn: My son loves books about dinosaurs.
My son really likes books about dinosaurs.
rubricZh: 用 dinosaur 表示「恐龍」，泛指用複數（例如 dinosaurs）
「很喜歡」可寫，例如 loves、really likes 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：例句 "big white blooms" 是名詞「花朵」，釋義「開花；花朵」把動詞義放前面，干擾項「落葉／結果／發芽」也是動作義；與例句詞性不一致，建議釋義改「花朵；花」、干擾項改名詞（如葉子／果實／種子）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "花朵；（in bloom）開花中"（原 "開花；花朵"）；第③關疑似 10 一併：bloom 名詞 A2、動詞 C1，釋義以名詞為先
